text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000126 bills 99215 well above expectation in every complexity band, including many 0–1 condition visits, yet the small set of returned charts all support the billed level.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The elevation is not confined to complex patients: the 99215 share runs above the all-provider rate in every condition band. The low-complexity sample includes 0-condition visits coded only for rash, abdominal pain or URI (e.g., C0065850, C0065958, C0065759, C0065295), which is the pattern most consistent with upcoding. Against that, none of the 19 documented 99215 claims fell below the billed level, and examples such as C0065376 and C0065557 show high MDM with recorded minutes. However, records cover only a small share of claims, and the problems flag on about a quarter of notes plus repeated time entries raise the possibility of templated or inflated notes; C0065496, a single-condition 99215, appears among the problem-flagged notes. No audit trail was received, so cloning cannot be ruled out. A reviewer should first pull charts for the sampled 0-condition 99215 visits and request the EHR audit trail to check whether the documented complexity reflects the actual encounter."}
